request_fields: task prompt (paper Table 8: list medications) + disease and Symptom list (+ reason description as "provided content"); no verbatim question in release
notes: Benchmark exists only as part of the ClinicBench release (Liu et al., EMNLP 2024; ClinicBench is the suite and the own release). Prompt text per task is in Table 8 of the paper (https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.759.pdf); the release ships items without the prompt. 796 rows (one per disease, 796 unique), matching 796 in Table 1. The paper describes these as ChatDoctor patient-physician conversations, but the release contains a structured disease table (disease, symptoms, description, tests, medications) and no conversation text, so todo item_format "conversation" does not match; the model request must be assembled from the template. Ambiguous for RCQ-Map rendering. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.
